usedFor: MailChimp holds your subscribers and Reckon One your books, so each new subscriber can become a contact through “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new subscriber is added to an audience” in MailChimp, then “Create Contact” in Reckon One
bestTemplate.why: A subscriber who joins an audience is recorded in Reckon One, so finance and marketing share one contact list.

watchOut: Templates run both ways, so “Create Contact” and “New Contact” together can bounce the same person back and forth.
